JLPT 辞典数据来源 / Dictionary data and attribution

The imported datasets in content/dictionary/ and the corresponding data in the
published dictionary pages are available under CC BY-SA 4.0.
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/

OpenJLPT contributors, CC BY-SA 4.0
https://github.com/evanclan/OpenJLPT
https://github.com/evanclan/OpenJLPT/blob/main/NOTICE.md
Snapshot: 0d1d3410bec90bd4098a7c72de820543cb4f707c
OpenJLPT supplies the level lists, terminology, readings, grammar points and
examples. Its upstream sources include the following:

- Jonathan Waller's JLPT Resources, CC BY: https://www.tanos.co.uk/jlpt/
- JMdict and KANJIDIC2, Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group
  (EDRDG). These files are the property of EDRDG and are used in conformance
  with the EDRDG licence (CC BY-SA 4.0): https://www.edrdg.org/edrdg/licence.html
- Tatoeba contributors, CC BY 2.0 FR: https://tatoeba.org/
  https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/fr/
  Vocabulary examples carry a Tatoeba sentence ID in the HTML and source JSON.
  Contributor details: https://tatoeba.org/sentences/show/<sentence-id>

Chinese vocabulary-example translations are keyed by the Tatoeba Japanese
sentence ID and a digest of its text. Matched Mandarin translations from
Tatoeba's Japanese–Mandarin export (CC BY 2.0 FR) show a link to the original
Chinese sentence and its contributor. Traditional characters are converted
to simplified characters where needed. Chinese translations without a
Tatoeba attribution use the existing English parallel sentence and
Helsinki-NLP's OPUS-MT en-zh (Apache 2.0, conversion by gaudi), or were
reviewed against the original Japanese. Some retained translations were
produced using Meta AI's M2M-100 (MIT, conversion by gn64).
https://tatoeba.org/en/downloads
https://huggingface.co/Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt-en-zh
https://huggingface.co/gaudi/opus-mt-en-zh-ctranslate2
https://huggingface.co/facebook/m2m100_418M
https://huggingface.co/gn64/M2M100_418M_CTranslate2

Tomoshi (Y1Z), CC BY-SA 4.0
https://github.com/tomoshi-app/tomoshi-dict-data
https://github.com/tomoshi-app/tomoshi-dict-data/blob/main/NOTICE.md
Initial snapshot: https://github.com/tomoshi-app/tomoshi-dict-data/releases/tag/v2026-11-16
Tomoshi supplies the Chinese word and kanji glosses in the localized snapshot.
Those glosses were generated with AI assistance and have varying review coverage.

Changes here: imported and selected fields and examples, joined Chinese glosses
to JLPT entries, converted furigana, and combined the data with curated entries.
Simplified Chinese grammar glosses, example translations, formations and notes
in content/grammar-zh.json, content/grammar-examples-zh/ and
content/grammar-details-zh/ are adaptations of OpenJLPT under CC BY-SA 4.0.
The source English text is available in the Japanese UI.
JLPT levels are community estimates for study reference.

The mock-practice sets use the corresponding CC BY-SA 4.0 vocabulary,
readings and glosses for some questions. Japanese source examples from Tatoeba
are marked with a link to the original sentence and its contributor on the
practice card. Those examples may be shortened, stripped of furigana, or
adapted as fill-in-the-blank questions.
